title: Late-Charge Add-On to the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinance APR
content:
**Risk schedule — refinance rate.** The refinance APR on a balloon refinance of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is raised for recent late charges and returned payments, counted in the 12 calendar months ending on the refinance date:

| Balloon late charges in the 12 months | Balloon returned payments in the 12 months | Raise of the refinance APR |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | Any | 0.5 percentage points |
| Any | One or more | 0.5 percentage points |
| Exactly one | None | 0.25 percentage points |
| None | None | None |

A window of 12 calendar months ending on the refinance date takes in the dates on or before the refinance date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it; whole calendar months are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete.
